raw.details:
Guidelines:

  • Eligibility: Open to undergraduate students interested in web development, cybersecurity, programming, data analysis, cricket analytics, sports management, and related technical fields.
  • Team Size: Each team must consist of 3–4 members.
  • Inter-College Teams: Inter-college teams are allowed, subject to successful registration and approval by the organizers.
  • Inter-Specialization Teams: Inter-specialization teams are allowed and encouraged. Students from Computer Science, Information Science, Data Science, AI/ML, Electronics, and other relevant disciplines may participate together.
  • Event Type: Two-stage Cyber-Escape & Live IPL Auction Arena.
  • Number of Rounds: The competition consists of 2 rounds:
    • IPL Technical Escape Room
    • Live IPL Mega Auction
  • Duration: 6 hours.
  • Maximum Capacity: 40 teams.
  • Round 1: Teams participate in a multi-stage cyber-investigation challenge involving HTML, CSS, JavaScript, ciphers, cricket datasets, web analysis, and logical problem-solving.
  • Qualification: The top 8 teams from Round 1 qualify for Round 2.
  • Round 2: Qualified teams enter a simulated IPL Mega Auction environment with a virtual purse of ₹80 Crores.
  • Auction Format: Teams act as franchise management groups and participate in real-time digital bidding to build a competitive squad.
  • Squad Constraints: Teams must construct their roster while complying with the specified squad constraints announced by the organizers.
  • Evaluation: Teams will be evaluated based on successful completion of Round 1 challenges and their performance in the auction, including strategic bidding and squad construction.
  • Registration: Registration requires organizer approval. The registration fee is ₹200 per team, paid online by the team lead.
  • Venue: Ramaiah Technology Campus, Bengaluru.
  • Event Dates: 14–16 October 2026; the official schedule lists HAMMER on 15 October 2026, 9:00 AM–3:00 PM.
  • Prizes: 1st – ₹7,000; 2nd – ₹5,000; 3rd – ₹3,000.

Rules:

  • Each team must consist of 3–4 registered members.
  • Teams must remain together throughout the competition and may not substitute members without organizer approval.
  • All teams must report and complete registration/check-in before the start of the event.
  • Round 1 must be completed within the time allocated by the organizers.
  • Participants must solve the assigned technical challenges using the information and resources permitted during the event.
  • Teams must not interfere with another team's computer, workspace, network environment, challenge platform, or progress.
  • Unauthorized access to another team's account, files, systems, or challenge environment is strictly prohibited.
  • Any attempt to manipulate, damage, bypass, or compromise the event's technical infrastructure may result in immediate disqualification.
  • Teams must independently solve the assigned challenges. Unauthorized assistance from other teams is not permitted.
  • The technical escape-room challenges may involve HTML, CSS, JavaScript, cipher decoding, cricket datasets, web analysis, and logical reasoning.
  • Only the top 8 qualifying teams from Round 1 will proceed to the Live IPL Mega Auction.
  • Each qualifying team will receive a virtual purse of ₹80 Crores for the auction.
  • Teams must use their virtual purse responsibly and may not exceed the allocated amount.
  • All auction bids must be placed through the official digital bidding system or procedure provided by the organizers.
  • Once a bid is accepted/confirmed according to the auction procedure, it cannot be withdrawn unless the organizers explicitly permit it.
  • Teams must construct their squad while following all player, squad-size, role, and other auction constraints specified by the organizers.
  • Teams must not manipulate the auction system, interfere with another team's bidding terminal, or attempt to obtain unauthorized information.
  • Participants must follow the instructions of auction coordinators and judges at all times.
  • Any cheating, collusion between teams, unauthorized communication, system manipulation, or other unfair practice may result in disqualification.
  • Participants must maintain proper conduct toward organizers, judges, volunteers, and other teams.
  • Any intentional damage to computers, bidding terminals, venue equipment, or other property may result in penalties and/or recovery of the associated cost.
  • In case of technical issues, participants must immediately notify the event coordinators. The organizers will decide the appropriate corrective action.
  • Judges/coordinators may impose penalties for violations of the competition rules.
  • In case of a tie, the organizers may use additional technical performance or auction-related criteria as a tie-breaker.
  • The judges' decision regarding challenge validity, qualification, bidding, penalties, scoring, and final results will be final and binding.
  • The organizers reserve the right to modify the sequence or operational procedure of a round if required for technical or organizational reasons.

Event Format:

Team Size: 3–4 members
Duration: 6 hours
Maximum Teams: 40
Event Type: Cyber-Escape + IPL Auction Challenge

Round 1 — IPL Technical Escape Room:

Teams enter a multi-stage cyber-investigation environment and solve technical challenges involving:

  • HTML inspection
  • CSS analysis
  • JavaScript analysis
  • Cipher decoding
  • Cricket dataset analysis
  • Logical problem-solving
  • Web-component investigation

Teams must solve the challenges and unlock the required master qualification keys to progress.

Round 2 — Live IPL Mega Auction:

The top 8 teams from Round 1 qualify for the live auction.

Each qualifying team receives a virtual purse of ₹80 Crores and operates as an IPL franchise. Teams participate in real-time digital bidding across marquee and accelerated sets and must construct their final squad while complying with the specified squad constraints.

Competition Flow:

Registration → Technical Escape Room → Top 8 Qualification → Live IPL Mega Auction → Final Evaluation → Results

  • Venue: Ramaiah Technology Campus, Bengaluru
  • Date: 15 October 2026
  • Time: 9:00 AM – 3:00 PM
  • Registration Fee: ₹200 per team
  • Prizes: ₹7,000 (1st) | ₹5,000 (2nd) | ₹3,000 (3rd)
